reviews.comment: 2 blockers: ChainLinkSchema.when must be single-line/max-length (forged 'chain next:' line can flip gated→auto); set-flow ignores chainId (chained ready task can leave its chain). 8 non-blocking follow-ups; core logic correct, 384/384 tests green.
Human: authoring composer flow must also know how to create chains (flow→flow relationship) — composer MCP + /task-authoring-* have no chain support yet; Round 1 AI blockers stay open.

fix.comment: Fixed blockers 1–3: single-line when (max 200); set-flow keeps chained task in its chain; composer MCP + authoring prompts know chains (create_chain/update_chain, describe, list/get/delete), shared loadRegistriesForWrite also guards MCP flow edits.
